title: Bias and Variance of a Least Squares Model
body:
Suppose you are estimating a true function $$g(z)=Az**{2}$$ for $$z$$ a real number, i.e. $$z$$ is a scalar, with ordinary least squares linear regression, where the model is $$f_{	heta}(z)=	heta{z}$$ and $$	heta$$ is a real number.
We train the model with just one training data point $$x, y$$ generated according to the following.
$$Y=g(x)+\epsilon$$
Assume $$\epsilon$$ is normally distributed with mean $$0$$ and variance $$\sigma**{2}$$
For the rest of the question, assume $$x=1$$
